primary_claim: Two new datasets (154 statements on Trump-vs-Harris views; 759 statements on Pew's political-typology groups) combine political statements with quantitative Pew Research data on group-level agreement rates, enabling measurement of blatant and politically-targeted sycophancy in LLMs.
stated_future_work: evaluate other LLMs (e.g. GPT-4o) against these datasets
limitations_stated: I am a bit less certain about the selected descriptions of political opinions here... I think more tuning could be done in those
it was hard to put my finger on the exact dividing line between factual/demographic information and opinions
quote: combining a diverse set of political statements with quantitative data on the degree to which different political groups (dis)agree with those statements
